title: Yeti
wikitext:
[[image:yeti.png|thumb|]]

A large, furry [[Humanoid|humanoid]] animal that usually lives in or near a cave.  Some of the varieties in colder regions breathe ice breath. '''Yeti''' are [[Skinnable|skinnable]], unlike most humanoids.  Yeti can be found in [[Feralas]], The [[Hillsbrad Foothills]], [[Winterspring]], [[Dun Morogh]], and The [[Alterac Mountains]].

Also called a [[Wendigo]].
